name: Active - Conceal
description:
Active: Conceals you and nearby allied heroes, granting 40% extra Movement Speed for 5s, or until taking or dealing damage.

When near allied heroes, you gain 30% EXP and Gold from minions and creeps. Dealing damage to enemy heroes (Cooldown: 15s) or revealing enemies also grants EXP and Gold. This skill can only be unlocked after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving.

description: Unique Passive - Trust: Allow allied Jawhead to fling you.

story: After taking control of the Barren Lands, the humans found this ancient armor among the Orcs, which uses far more advanced technology and contains a miraculous power.

Unique Passive - Blessing: Accumulate 1000 Gold via Devotion and Thriving to unlock a skill.
During the first 5 minutes, Minion rewards are reduced to 50% when earned alone. After 2 minutes, Roaming Blessing can no longer be enchanted.

name: Berserker's Fury
description:
Unique Attribute: +30% Crit Damage
Unique Passive - Doom: When Basic Attack Crit, they deal extra True Damage equal to 12% of the damage before reduction.
story: A forgotten relic, lost in the Endless War. If the pain of the past ultimately leads to greater despair, then madness is only a step away.
tips: Best equipped by Physical heroes that rely on Critical Damage.

name: Black Ice Shield
description: Unique Passive - Fortress Shield: For each enemy hero within 5 units, Physical & Magic Defense is increased by 4, up to 20.
story: The archaeologists in the Land of Dawn have not reached a clear conclusion about this piece of equipment.

name: Blade Armor
description:
Unique Attribute: +20% Crit Damage Reduction
Unique Passive - Bladed Armor: When struck by a Basic Attack, deals Physical Damage equal to 30 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% of the incoming damage (calculated before Damage Reduction) to the attacker and slows them by 15% for 1s.
story: The toughest and most fealess knight of the Moniyan Empire once used it to overpower his enemies with an unyielding will to fight.
tips: Best equipped by Tanks to fight enemy Marksmen that have great Attack Speed.

name: Blade of Despair
description: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2 seconds (takes effect before the damage is dealt).
story: The most fearsome fighters have their own demons to face, and so the sharpest blades in their hands speak their deepset despair.
tips: Best equipped by Physical heroes to greatly increase their Physical Attack attributes in the late game.

name: Blade of the Heptaseas
description:
Unique Attribute: +15 Physical Penetration
Unique Passive - Ambush: If no damage is taken or dealt within 5 seconds (excluding from Minions or Creeps), the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 160 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slow the target by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
story: The blade that cuts bones like butter was once lost with the Frozen King in the deep sea. Now it waits for the right moment to awaken its power.
tips: Best equipped by Physical Assassins that need to deal more damage and increase Crowd Control abilities.

name: Blood Wings
description: Unique Passive - Guard: Gains a 800 <scaleAP>(+100% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> Shield that will regenerate 20 seconds after being damaged. The Shield also grants 30 Movement Speed while it lasts and 150 Movement Speed for 1 second after it breaks.
story: The crimson red dyed the spotless white feather, as if the brutal past of the Askati Forest was buried within it.
tips: Final equipment for Magic heroes in the late game.

name: Bloody Retribution
description:
Active: Retribution's damage against creeps and minions is increased to 150%. When cast on an enemy hero, deals them 100 True Damage and steals HP equal to 300 plus 24% of the caster's extra HP from them for 3s.

Retribution is upgraded when the total number of creep kills, hero kills, and assists reaches 5.

name: Book of Sages
story: The archaeologists in the Land of Dawn have not reached a clear conclusion about this piece of equipment.

name: Boots
story: The archaeologists in the Land of Dawn have not reached a clear conclusion about this piece of equipment.

description: Unique Passive - Heart Broken: Become immune to allied Cecilion's Moonlit Waltz in this match.
story: The archaeologists in the Land of Dawn have not reached a clear conclusion about this piece of equipment.

name: Brute Force Breastplate
description: Unique Passive - Brute Force: Each second after dealing damage, gain 8 extra Adaptive Attack and 2% extra Movement Speed for 4 seconds, up to 6 stacks. Gain 25% extra Control Duration Reduction at full stacks.
story: The people of the Northern Vale always find their own way. Lacking power? Grab a stronger weapon! Lacking in defense? Grab a stronger armor!
tips: Best equipped by Fighters that need good sustainability.

name: Chastise Pauldron
description:
Unique Passive - Chastise: Taking damage will reduce the Attack Speed and Attack Speed cap of the attacker to 75% of normal for 2 seconds.
Unique Passive - Redemption: When incoming damage reduces HP below 30%, recover 20% Max HP over the next 2 seconds. This effect has a 60 seconds cooldown.
story: In the western reaches of Land of Dawn amidst the Misty Mountains, a centaur guardian dons the sacred pauldron to punish any enemy who dares to invade.
tips: Ideal for countering heroes with high Attack Speed

name: Clock of Destiny
description:
Unique Passive - Destiny: Gains 4.5(+0.5*Hero Level) Hybrid Defense for 5 seconds when dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes, stacking up to 6 times (can gain 1 stack every 0.4 second).
Unique Passive - Gift: When HP drops below 50%, recovers 15% of HP over the next 3 seconds. When Mana drops below 50%, restores 15% of Mana over the next 3 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
story: Eruditio's latest product creatively combines Starlium with magic and time, providing a variety of enhancements to power and growth.
tips: Best equipped by Magic Tanks to increase their laning sustainability and durability.

name: Concentrated Energy
description:
Unique Attribute: +20% Hybrid Lifesteal
Unique Passive - Recharge: Increases Magic Power by 5 after dealing Magic Damage (this effect stacks up to 6 times and can only gain 1 stack every 0.4 second). When reaching full stacks, increases Magic Damage by 12% for 5 seconds.
story: Inspired by the explosion of the Infinite Gateway, it was invented by scientists according to the condensation and amplification trajectories of energies.
tips: Best equipped by Magic heroes to increase their sustainability when dealing high damage.

name: Corrosion Scythe
description:
Unique Passive - Corrosive: Basic Attacks gain 80 extra Physical Damage and slow the target by 8% (halved for ranged Basic Attacks) for 1.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
Unique Passive - Impulse: Basic Attacks grant 6% extra Attack Speed for 3 seconds, capped at 5 stacks.
story: Those who live upon this land have never ceased fighting, but the fiercest struggles always stem from the fear of death.
tips: Best equipped by heroes that especially rely on Attack Speed and excel at picking off lone enemies.

name: Cursed Helmet
description:
Unique Passive - Burning Soul: Deals (1.2% Total HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies per second. This damage is increased by 125(+15*Hero Level)% against creeps and minions.
Unique Passive - Curse: Dealing damage with Burning Soul will reduce the target's Hybrid Defense by 3 for 3 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.
story: An altered nature lies dormant within the Blood Demons, turning into loneliness during the long nights. It is a curse that keeps them in limbo between Light and Dark.
tips: Best equipped by Tanks to increase their damage or lane clearing abilities.

Unique Passive - Devour: Each Basic Attack recovers 10 (+4*Hero Level) HP. This effect is halved against minions.
story: A blade with its core carved from the bones of an Iceland Golem, the power that resides within almost seems to impart the fierce history of those giants in the time before they were slain.
tips: Best equipped to fight Tanks. Can also be equipped by heroes that have great Attack Speed or can trigger the effect of their Basic Attack multiple times.

description:
Unique Attribute: +40% Magic Penetration
Unique Passive - Spellbreaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Magic Penetration for each point of the enemy's Magic Defense, capped at 20%.
story: In a past battle between the Elves and the Moniyan Empire, the ancestors of House Alvin used this blade to break through the Elves' defenses and achieve victory.
tips: Best equipped by Magic DPS heroes to counter enemy heroes that have high Defense abilities in the late game.

description:
Unique Passive - Fortress Shield: For each enemy hero within 5 units, Physical & Magic Defense is increased by 8, up to 40.
Unique Passive - Lifebane: Reduces shield and HP Regen of nearby enemies within 5 units to 60% of normal for 1s.
story: A shield kept in Swan Castle that symbolizes the gallant past of Prince Alvin, who gave up his throne for love.
tips: Best equipped by Tanks to reduce enemies' Regen effects (Heal, Shields or Lifesteal).

tips: Best equipped by Mage or Support heroes that especially rely on cooldown reduction or Mana Regen.

name: Flask of the Oasis
description:
Unique Attribute: +12% Healing Effect
Unique Passive - Blessing: When casting a healing or shield skill, if the target's HP is below 35%, or falls below 35% within 3 seconds, they will get a (100*Hero Level) shield that lasts 3 seconds. When this effect triggers, it also reduces the cooldown of the caster's skills by 2 seconds. This effect can only trigger once every 60 seconds on the same target, and will not trigger on self-only healing and shield skills.
story: Mages mimicked the magic of the Oasis, hoping to protect more people with the power of the martyr.
tips: Suitable for heroes with healing or shielding skills to support teammates.

name: Fleeting Time
description: Unique Passive - Timestream: Hero kills or assists reduce the Ultimate's current cooldown by 30%.
story: A precious artifact kept in the private room of an envoy of the Monastery of Light. The envoy often gazes upon it with longing, as if reminiscing about her brother in Abyss and a broken memory.
tips: Best equipped by heroes who rely heavily on Ultimates.

name: Flower of Hope
description: Unique Passive - Flower of Hope: Every 6 seconds, the next skill or Basic Attack deals an additional 100 (+40% Total Physical Attack) (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
story: The equipment that Floryn shares with her teammates takes no equipment slot

name: Fury Hammer
description: Unique Attribute: +12 Physical Penetration
story: The archaeologists in the Land of Dawn have not reached a clear conclusion about this piece of equipment.

name: Genius Wand
description:
Unique Attribute: +10 Magic Penetration
Unique Passive - Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 3+(0.3*Hero Level) for 2 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.
story: A product of Ursula's random experiment, later granted to a certain promising young magician by the Magic Academy.
tips: Best equipped by Magic heroes that deal multi-stage damage to greatly increase their damage.

name: Glowing Wand
description:
Unique Passive - Scorch: Dealing Magic Damage burns the targets for 3 seconds, also dealing extra Magic Damage equal to 1% of the target's Max HP per second.
Unique Passive - Lifebane: Dealing damage to the target will reduce the Shield and HP Regen effects on them to 60% of normal for 3 seconds.
story: A magic staff that was long lost after the Battle of the Fire Throat now returns with the Son of Flames. The magic that flows through it is madness burning in flames.
tips: Best equipped by Magic heroes to reduce enemies' Regen effects (Heal, Shields, or Lifesteal)

name: Golden Staff
description:
Unique Passive - Swift: Every 1% extra Crit Chance gained is converted into 1% extra Attack Speed.
Unique Passive - Endless Strike: After every 2 non-Crit Basic Attacks, the Attack Speed of the next Basic Attack is increased by 80% (and Attack Speed cap is increased to 500%) and triggers Attack Effects an additional 2 time(s).
story: "How can I be invincible?" A young panda warrior once asked his mentor, the immortal monkey. The monkey answered nothing, only waving his staff impatiently, causing a storm in an instant.
tips: Best equipped by heroes whose Basic Attacks have special effects. Can also be equipped with Demon Hunter Sword, Feather of Heaven and other equipment.

name: Great Dragon Spear
description: Unique Passive - Supreme Warrior: After casting an Ultimate, increase Movement Speed by 30% for 7.5 seconds. This effect has a 15 seconds cooldown.
story: The treasure of the Dragon Altar symbolizes power and responsibility, passing on the never-ending legacy of the Cadia Riverlands.
tips: Suitable for heroes relying on Crit Chance and CD Reduction to improve mobility.

name: Guardian Helmet
description:
Unique Passive - Recovery: After 5s out of combat, recover (2.5% Total HP) HP per second.
Unique Passive - Defender: Upon taking more than 500 damage in a single instance, the excess damage beyond that amount is reduced by 30 (0.3% Total HP)%.
story: Blessed by the Elves as they fought side-by-side with humans, the armor possesses an extraordinary healing power.
tips: Best equipped by heroes that rely extremely on HP. Can also be equipped by Tanks that re-enter the battlefield after taking a round of damage.

name: Haas' Claws
description:
Unique Attribute: +20% Lifesteal
Unique Passive - Frenzy: Critical strikes grant 20% extra Attack Speed for 2 seconds.
story: Those who lost the war were banished to the Abyss with an insatiable hunger for the blood that represents power. Haas was the first to succumb to his desire when he bowed to the Queen.
tips: Best equipped by Marksmen or Fighters that rely on Basic Attacks to increase their sustainability when dealing high damage.

Unique Passive - Thriving: Unique in Team: Gain 6 Gold and 12 EXP every 5s. After 8 minutes into the match, gain an additional 66% boost (only triggers when you have the lowest Gold among all heroes with active Roaming Blessing on your team).
Unique Passive - Blessing: Accumulate 1000 Gold via Devotion and Thriving to unlock a skill.
During the first 5 minutes, Minion rewards are reduced to 50% when earned alone. After 2 minutes, Roaming Blessing can no longer be enchanted.

name: War Axe
description:
Unique Passive - Fighting Spirit: Attacks grant 12 extra Physical Attack per second for 4 seconds, up to 6 stacks. Deals 10% extra True Damage based on the damage dealt (no damage reduction counted) at full stacks.
Marksmen, Mages, and Supports only receive 50% of these stacked effects.
story: This battleaxe is said to have been wielded by the Leonins' ancestors as they resisted the Abyss forces, along with the Elves. When they could fight no longer, the weapon and its power fell into a deep slumber. As of late, it has been awoken by the rage and battle spirit of a certain Leonin warrior.
tips: Best equipped by Fighters that need good sustainability.

name: Wind of Nature
description: Active Skill - Wind Chant: Become immune to all Physical Damage for 2 seconds (duration is halved for non-Marksmen; 90 seconds cooldown).
story: A gem from the depths of the Azrya Woodlands, rich with natural energies, was forged into a longbow by the Elves to protect their sanctuary, the Moonlit Forest.
tips: Best equipped by Markmen that need to fight Physical Assassins or other Physical Marksmen. Requires accurate control.

name: Windtalker
description: Unique Passive - Typhoon: Every 5–2 seconds (reduced by 0.2 seconds for each Basic Attack), the next Basic Attack will hit up to 3 enemy units for 150–362 Magic Damage. (This attack can Crit and the damage increases to 200% against Minions.)
story: It once determined the fate of the Twin Cities, Wind Fort and Fire Throat, and later its sharp edge witnessed a decades-long promise between two best friends.
tips: Best equipped by Physical Basic Attack heroes that rely on Attack Speed and Movement Speed.

name: Winter Crown
description: Active Skill - Frozen: Becomes frozen, untargetable, and immune to damage for 2 seconds (100 seconds cooldown). Cannot move or cast skills while frozen, but skills already cast won't be interrupted.
story: The core of the Glacier was created by the Lord of Light. Having awakened along with the Maiden of the Glacier, it symbolizes the power of eternity that not only protects but also confines her.
tips: Best equipped by Assassins and Mages to avoid damage in the late game. Requires accurate control.

name: Wishing Lantern
description: Unique Passive - Butterfly Goddess: For every 800 Magic Damage dealt to an enemy hero (calculated before Damage Reduction), a Butterfly Goddess is summoned to attack the enemy hero, dealing Magic Damage equal to 8% of their Current HP.
story: A lantern left by the guardian of Cadia Riverlands that contains infinite wishes. A mysterious girl now lights it, summoning Crimson Butterflies and guiding lost spirits.
tips: Suitable for Magic heroes when up against high-HP enemy heroes.
